full_run.note: Includes observed setup/controls. Total requires measured adjudicator effort. Equal workers per role; no scaling efficiency guarantee. Provisional denominator omits unknown missing rows.

bootstrap.total_interval: Page bootstrap + adjudicator task bootstrap + Jeffreys beta disagreement-rate draws; planning interval, not a population guarantee

coordinator_ledger.token_definition: Measured combined task totals; input/cached/output categories remain as returned; not a price

column_task_projection.assumptions: One task per column per blind/assisted role, one adjudication task per disputed column including controls. Role-stratified reader task bootstrap, adjudicator task bootstrap, Jeffreys disputed-column share. Observed setup/controls included; column lengths and continuation effort assumed exchangeable with sampled tasks. Ideal wall time divides summed effort by concurrency; excludes rate limits, scheduling and phase dependencies. Combined tokens cannot determine dollars.

estimand_note: Unseen-target agreement is measured only after paired readings; target accuracy requires independent source adjudication.
